purpose: Define deterministic preconditions for state transitions using exact state, evidence, policy, time or resource conditions.

topics.name: Transition Guard
topics.purpose: Define deterministic preconditions for state transitions using exact state, evidence, policy, time or resource conditions.

semantics.identity_rule: Reusable guard may have explicit identity.
semantics.evaluation_rule: Guard evaluation is read-only by default.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown required guard result blocks transition.
semantics.authorization_rule: Functional guards do not replace AccessCore authorization.
semantics.time_rule: Temporal guards use exact clock/profile semantics.
semantics.evidence_rule: Guard result may be recorded as transition evidence.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: same state name used instead of identity
